title: Linear functions (concept-model fixture)

goals: Predict how slope and intercept change a line

intake.capability: Predict how slope and intercept change a line

decisions.decision: Offer the diagnostic so known prerequisites can get a quick pass; keep the full core route available.
Lead each full lesson with a visual model and a manipulable activity before the long explanation.

assumptions: Test fixture with a synthetic learner profile

outcomes.text: Predict how changing the slope or the intercept moves a line
Compute the value of a linear function at a given input

glossary.definition: How much the output changes for each unit increase of the input; m in y = m·x + b.
The output when the input is 0; b in y = m·x + b.

knowledgeArchitecture.summary: Slope and intercept are hierarchical (evaluation depends on both); rate of change is a lens that reappears in other topics; checking a model against values is a disposition.

concepts.label: Rate of change as a lens

hubs.label: Change
hubs.lens: Every model describes how one quantity changes with another

dispositions.label: Checking a model against known values

bands.descriptor: Accepts the plotted result without checking.
Checks one value by hand when prompted.
Checks values and states where the model stops applying, unprompted.

capstone.title: Read a real line
capstone.task: A taxi charges a fixed fee plus a price per kilometre. Write the function, explain what the slope and the intercept mean, and compute the price of a 7 km ride.

descriptors: Slope and intercept interpreted in context
